messages:
inc-bot: ALERT: Service gateway reports sustained 5xx spike and increased request timeouts for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 (5m avg 8.6% 5xx, baseline ~0.2%). Paging on-call.
amber_oncall: acked. paging ryan (primary). ping @ryan
ryan: on it. connecting to dashboards and logs now. can someone paste the metrics link?
luca_sre: metrics -> https://grafana.company/eu/gateway#range=5m
luca_sre: looking at upstreams, error pattern shows surge of 502/504 + backend 5xx from inference-gateway shard pref-12 and pref-15
nina_eng-runtime: adding context: we've been running an aggressive prefetch TTL reduction experiment in EU this morning. could be related.
ryan: running quick curl against gate health endpoint
ryan: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://gateway.eu/api/health" 
* Connected to gateway.eu (10.2.3.4) port 443
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"ok","kv_prefix_cache_ok":false}
``` 
ryan: kv_prefix_cache_ok=false flagged in /health. that's weird.
amber_oncall: putting on-call runbook link: https://wiki.company/incident-runbooks/kv-prefix-checks
olivia_cs: heads up — Product Support is seeing elevated error rates for a handful of customers on dedicated capacity (tickets coming in). tagging CS triage.
olivia_cs: customer-impact: some token-generation flows timing out, page users report timeouts ~10-15s then 502
nina_eng-runtime: what do kv logs show? any checksum or corruption alerts?
luca_sre: tailing prefix-cache logs on pref-12
luca_sre: ```
2026-03-15T09:02:11Z WARN prefix_cache: checksum_mismatch shard=12 prefix_id=0x4f3a
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z ERROR prefetch: eviction_burst triggered keys=1324
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z WARN gateway: upstream 10.4.5.6 returned 504
``` 
ryan: checksum_mismatch + eviction_burst. could be a compaction/rotation bug in the prefix index causing stale pointers.
nina_eng-runtime: I'm going to pause the EU prefetch experiment and disable prefetch on pref-12/pref-15 via feature flag. deploying now.
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: toggle-prefetch-eu -> prod. CI build 1245. ETA ~45s
ryan: while that's rolling, can we mitigate by routing traffic away from pref-12/pref-15? set smart-routing policy -> avoid-pref-12-15
luca_sre: applying temporary routing rule to route new sessions away from those shards. will keep current sessions sticky.
luca_sre: applied. observability: new requests to gateway now hitting pref-20/pref-21. 1m delay expected for stickiness.
amber_oncall: coordinating with networking: are there any gateway pools impacted beyond prefix cache? any host-level OOMs?
luca_sre: checked nodes. no OOMs, CPU fine. network latencies normal. issue localized to prefix cache checksums and rapid eviction.
ryan: checking if automatic fallback to model-variant worked for affected requests
ryan: logs show fallback attempted but fallback also saw cache misses due to prefix lookup failing, resulting in upstream 502 cascade.
olivia_cs: sending templated message to customers who hit errors: "We're investigating elevated errors for generation requests in EU; engineers are mitigating. We will follow up when we have more detail." will post in support thread.
nina_eng-runtime: deploy-bot reports prefetch toggle succeeded. prefetch flag disabled on pref-12/pref-15.
deploy-bot: Toggle complete: toggle-prefetch-eu -> prod SUCCESS
luca_sre: after flag flip, eviction rate for pref-12 dropped 80% in 30s. 5xx rate trending down from 8.6% -> 1.9% in 5m window.
ryan: that's promising. running additional health check against /health
ryan: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://gateway.eu/api/health
{"status":"degraded","kv_prefix_cache_ok":false,"active_evictions":3}
```
ryan: cache still reporting checksum_mismatch on some prefixes but eviction bursts reduced. 5xx still above baseline though.
nina_eng-runtime: starting read-only repair job to revalidate prefix checksums (non-blocking). kicking off on pref-12 first.
luca_sre: watch logs for any repair-induced CPU spikes; throttling set to 10% so should be safe.
amber_oncall: any need to escalate to on-call ENG runtime leads? nina and ryan are on it.
ryan: agree, feel comfortable keeping SRE/Runtime in-loop; escalating if repair job triggers further issues.
olivia_cs: support has paused contacting customers; will update once 5xx < 0.5% and rolling windows stable.
luca_sre: repair job started. logs:
``` 
2026-03-15T09:08:05Z INFO repair: validating prefix=0x4f3a status=queue
2026-03-15T09:08:09Z INFO repair: validated prefix=0x4f3a checksum=0x1a2b expected=0x1a2b status=ok
2026-03-15T09:08:12Z INFO repair: validated prefix=0x4f3b checksum=0xdead expected=0xbeef status=fix_scheduled
``` 
ryan: one prefix needed a fix; repair scheduled. no user traffic impacted yet.
amber_oncall: good. let's prepare a short incident summary for the handoff. Next on-call: @luca_sre will be primary in 30m? actually Luca off at 09:40 — handoff to @sre_second after.
luca_sre: I'll stay until handoff; I'll make sure the routing rule persists and repair job finishes or is safe to leave.
olivia_cs: current customer impact: ~0.6% of requests in EU experienced an error in the last 15m, several CS tickets opened but no escalations to executive level. ETA for normalizing: 15-30m given repair progress.
ryan: mitigation checklist completed: disabled prefetch experiment, applied routing avoidance, started repair, throttled repairs, updated CS. Recommend continuing monitoring and keeping feature flagged off until postmortem.
nina_eng-runtime: agreed. I'll prepare a postmortem draft and include the prefetch experiment as a likely contributing factor (race between compaction + prefetch eviction). will also add follow-ups: stricter checksum alerts, safer prefetch rollout gating, and a canary that validates prefix checksums pre-deploy.
amber_oncall: handoff notes: incident ID INC-20260315-04, primary responders: ryan, luca, nina. Current status: mitigation in place, 5xx down from peak, repair running. next update at 09:45 or on completion.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploys paused for eu region until incident cleared.
ryan: ETA repair job for all flagged prefixes ~12m. I'll stay on for monitoring and handoff.
olivia_cs: support message updated: "Errors are decreasing, we are running a repair job on the cache; expected recovery within 30 minutes. Monitoring will continue and we'll follow up with a summary."
amber_oncall: thanks team. paging cleared for now; keep this thread active for the handoff. :heart:
sre_second: taking over in 30m. please DM any urgent state changes.
ryan: will DM and update this thread when repairs finish or if we see regression.
luca_sre: repair completed on remaining prefixes at 09:20. final metrics: 5xx 5m avg down to 0.22% — near baseline.
ryan: confirming. running final health check:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://gateway.eu/api/health
{"status":"ok","kv_prefix_cache_ok":true,"active_evictions":0}
```
ryan: all green. closing incident in 10m after ensuring no regressions.
amber_oncall: incident closed at 09:30; postmortem owner: nina_eng-runtime. action items: 1) revert prefetch experiment or harden it; 2) add checksum preflight; 3) improve warning thresholds for eviction bursts. I'll link the PM when ready.
olivia_cs: adding CS summary to ticket thread and notifying affected customers with final status.
inc-bot: Incident INC-20260315-04 status -> RESOLVED (duration 28m)."
